description:
How many people lodging a tax return in each postcode work in each of nine occupation groups (plus not stated), per income year 2018-19 to 2023-24.

Coverage: About 2,530 postcodes; income years 2018-19 to 2023-24. Current to 2024-06-30. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/taxpayer-occupation`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: occ_not_stated, occ_managers, occ_professionals, occ_technicians_trades, occ_community_personal_service, occ_clerical_admin, occ_sales, occ_machinery_drivers, occ_labourers, occ_apprentices_trainees. Omit for all.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: postcodes_economy_taxpayer_occupation
title: Taxpayers by occupation by postcode
